# Homestill

[Homestill](https://homestill.app/) is an independent native Home Assistant app for Android (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, 4.1 MB) and iPhone (SwiftUI, no third-party libraries) that does two things, room-based device controls and live cameras over low-latency HLS (0.2 to 0.65 seconds to first frame in tests, falling back to a one-second still), while leaving out dashboards, history, automations and settings editing. It carries everything over one WebSocket, draws the last known state at once on launch, updates tiles on tap before the server answers, signs in inside the app with two-factor support keeping only a refresh token, and has no account, analytics or tracking. Homestill is in testing with no public download yet, is coming to the App Store and Google Play, and is not affiliated with Home Assistant.
